layman_headline: Market fear is easing but no new high-conviction setups — sitting tight with current positions.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is still in 'Fear' mode at 34/100, though sentiment is slowly improving from last week's 29. Bitcoin is flat around $63,000 and dominating the market at 56%, which makes it harder for smaller coins to rally. Our two existing positions — Solana and Chainlink — are slightly underwater but well within their stop-loss ranges. The swing trade candidates available today are either wildly overextended (up 45-158% in a week) or falling knives with no clear bottom, so there's no compelling new entry right now.
layman_action: Hold your current SOL and LINK positions. Both are near entry prices with stops in place. Don't chase the coins that have already pumped 50-150% this week — those are traps in a fearful market. Wait for a cleaner setup.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates are problematic: CYS/VELVET/AKE are parabolic with 45-158% weekly gains and no RSI/MACD data to confirm continuation — classic momentum exhaustion risk in a Fear environment. UNI is down 18.9% in 7 days and -92.8% from ATH, a falling knife with no visible catalyst or technical support confirmation. INJ is similarly bleeding. FDUSD/RLUSD are stablecoins. Our existing positions in SOL ($75.14, -1.3%) and LINK ($9.31, -2.6%) are both within normal volatility ranges and above their stop-losses. LINK's 6.6% daily gain with $470M volume and the Israel bank/Galaxy trading news provide a legitimate fundamental backdrop. High BTC dominance at 56.1% continues to suppress alt performance, making new alt entries risky without exceptional setups.
risk_factors: BTC dominance at 56.1% continues to drain capital from alts — if BTC drops below $60K, all alt positions face amplified downside
Fear & Greed at 34 is improving but still fragile — any negative macro catalyst could push sentiment back to Extreme Fear
LINK's 13.1% weekly gain may be extended and could retrace before continuation, testing our $8.60 stop-loss
watch_list: BTC price action around $63K support — a break below $60K would trigger defensive exits on alt positions
LINK volume sustainability above $400M daily — declining volume after this rally signals exhaustion
Fear & Greed trend — if it crosses above 40 into Neutral, it would support adding a new alt position
market_context: Bitcoin trades sideways at $63K with 56.1% dominance, creating a difficult environment for altcoin swing trades. Fear & Greed is improving from 29 to 34 but remains cautious, and institutional news (Israel bank crypto, Trump White House meeting) could shift sentiment.
context_banner: Market in cautious recovery from deep fear — existing positions intact, but no new high-conviction entries available among overextended or falling candidates.

key_signals.description: Fear at 34 improving from 29 weekly average — sentiment bottoming but not yet confirming a risk-on environment for new alt entries.
Israel's largest bank partnering with Galaxy for crypto trading and Trump White House crypto CEO meeting suggest growing institutional adoption, supporting LINK's oracle/tokenization narrative.
All swing candidates show extreme 7-day moves (CYS +45%, VELVET +158%, AKE +137%) without RSI confirmation — classic overextension patterns in a fearful market.
LINK's $470M daily volume on a +6.6% day stands out as the strongest volume-backed move among top 20 coins, suggesting real demand rather than thin-market speculation.
No RSI data available for any swing candidates, reducing confidence in timing entries — without oversold confirmation, dip-buying carries elevated risk.
